name: dolorous blow

attributes.attribute: appears in stories of the Fisher King
was an accidental blow to the groin
struck the blow against his brother the Fisher King
caused the land to become barren

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The dolorous blow is an Arthurian motif. It appears in stories of the Fisher King. This is the accidental blow his brother Balin struck to the king's groin. The wound made the land barren.
objective: Record the dolorous blow as the Arthurian motif that blighted the Fisher King's land.
key_results: The dolorous blow is an Arthurian motif in the Fisher King stories.
Balin struck the blow accidentally to his brother's groin.
The blow caused the land to become barren.
